title: Orchestra watcher fetcher input (protocol v1)
description: The JSON document Orchestra writes to a watcher fetcher's stdin on every tick.

protocolVersion.description: Fetcher protocol version. Always "1" for v1.

watcher.description: Watcher name (the library map key, or the inline definition's name).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous successful fetch, or null on the first run / after a state reset. Orchestra never interprets it.

subscribers.description: Orchestration ids currently subscribed to this watcher. Informational; fetchers may ignore it.

config.description: Verbatim copy of the watcher's fetch.config block, or null when it has none.
